newsitem.title: USA: Pacific USA converts loan to 1.5 mln Monaco shares.
newsitem.headline: Pacific USA converts loan to 1.5 mln Monaco shares.

text.p: Monaco Finance Inc said Wednesday that privately-held Pacific USA Holdings Corp has converted its outstanding $3 million loan to Monaco into 1.5 million shares of its restricted Class A common stock.

In connection with the transaction, the company said that Pacific has granted a proxy to vote half of those shares to Morris Ginsburg, its chairman, and the other half to Irwin Sandler, its executive vice president.

Monaco said its goals for the remainder of 1997 include continued efforts to improve its financing flexibility and that the conversion of the Pacific loan was a positive step towards achieving these goals.
Monaco is a secondary auto finance company specializing in acquiring, from automobile dealerships, retail installment contracts of purchasers of new and late model automobiles.
